front: O contrato de locação tem vigência de trinta meses, conforme a Lei do Inquilinato.
pronunciation: oo kohn-TRAH-too jee loh-kah-SOWNG teng vee-ZHEHN-syah jee TREEN-tah MEH-zeez, kohn-FOHR-mee ah LAY doo een-kee-lee-NAH-too.
back: The lease runs for thirty months, in accordance with the Tenancy Law.
context: 'Vigência' = term/period in force. Brazil's 'Lei do Inquilinato' (Law 8.245/1991) governs residential leases; 30-month contracts give the landlord more protection.

front: A imobiliária exige fiador ou seguro-fiança como garantia.
pronunciation: ah ee-moh-bee-lee-AH-ryah eh-ZEE-zhee fee-ah-DOHR oh seh-GOO-roo-fee-AHN-sah KOH-moo gah-rahn-CHEE-ah.
back: The real estate agency requires a guarantor or rent-guarantee insurance as security.
context: Typical Brazilian rental guarantees: 'fiador' (a guarantor who owns property), 'seguro-fiança' (insurance) or 'caução' (deposit).

front: A caução corresponde a três meses de aluguel e será devolvida ao fim do contrato.
pronunciation: ah kow-SOWNG koh-rrehs-POHN-jee ah TREHS MEH-zeez jee ah-loo-GEH-oo ee seh-RAH deh-vohl-VEE-dah ah-oo FEENG doo kohn-TRAH-too.
back: The deposit is equivalent to three months' rent and will be returned at the end of the contract.
context: 'Caução' = security deposit. By law it can't exceed three months of rent.

front: Em caso de rescisão antecipada, o inquilino pagará multa proporcional ao tempo restante.
pronunciation: eng KAH-zoo jee rreh-see-ZOWNG ahn-teh-see-PAH-dah, oo een-kee-LEE-noo pah-gah-RAH MOOL-tah proh-pohr-syoh-NOW ah-oo TEHM-poo rrehs-TAHN-chee.
back: In case of early termination, the tenant will pay a penalty proportional to the remaining time.
context: 'Rescisão' = termination of a contract. The proportional 'multa rescisória' is standard in Brazilian leases.

front: É preciso avisar o proprietário com trinta dias de antecedência.
pronunciation: EH preh-SEE-zoo ah-vee-ZAHR oo proh-pree-eh-TAH-ryoo kohng TREEN-tah JEE-ahz jee ahn-teh-seh-DEHN-syah.
back: You must give the landlord thirty days' notice.
context: 'Com X dias de antecedência' = with X days' notice. The written notice itself is the 'aviso prévio'.

front: O aluguel será reajustado anualmente pelo IPCA.
pronunciation: oo ah-loo-GEH-oo seh-RAH rreh-ah-zhoos-TAH-doo ah-noo-ah-oo-MEHN-chee PEH-loo ee-peh-seh-AH.
back: The rent will be adjusted annually according to the IPCA index.
context: 'Reajuste' = annual adjustment. Leases use an inflation index, usually IPCA or IGP-M.

front: O IPTU e a taxa de condomínio ficam por conta do inquilino.
pronunciation: oo ee-peh-teh-OO ee ah TAH-shah jee kohn-doh-MEE-nyoo FEE-kowng pohr KOHN-tah doo een-kee-LEE-noo.
back: The property tax and the building fees are the tenant's responsibility.
context: 'IPTU' = municipal property tax. 'Ficar por conta de' = to be someone's responsibility. Always check this clause.

front: Antes de entregar as chaves, faremos a vistoria do imóvel.
pronunciation: AHN-cheez jee ehn-treh-GAHR ahs SHAH-veez, fah-REH-mooz ah vees-toh-REE-ah doo ee-MOH-vehl.
back: Before handing over the keys, we'll do the property inspection.
context: 'Vistoria' = inspection with a written report of the property's condition, done at move-in and move-out. Take photos!

front: Qualquer dano além do desgaste natural será descontado da caução.
pronunciation: kwahl-KEHR DAH-noo ah-LENG doo jehz-GAHS-chee nah-too-RAH-oo seh-RAH jehs-kohn-TAH-doo dah kow-SOWNG.
back: Any damage beyond normal wear and tear will be deducted from the deposit.
context: 'Desgaste natural' = normal wear and tear. 'Descontar de' = to deduct from.

front: Preciso reconhecer firma no cartório para validar a assinatura.
pronunciation: preh-SEE-zoo rreh-koh-nyeh-SEHR FEER-mah noo kahr-TOH-ryoo PAH-rah vah-lee-DAHR ah ah-see-nah-TOO-rah.
back: I need to have my signature notarized at the registry office to validate it.
context: 'Reconhecer firma' = to certify a signature. The 'cartório' (notary/registry office) is central to Brazilian bureaucracy.

front: Traga uma cópia autenticada do passaporte e duas fotos três por quatro.
pronunciation: TRAH-gah OO-mah KOH-pyah ow-tehn-chee-KAH-dah doo pah-sah-POHR-chee ee DOO-ahs FOH-tooz TREHS pohr KWAH-troo.
back: Bring a certified copy of your passport and two 3x4 photos.
context: 'Cópia autenticada' = notarized copy. 'Foto 3x4' (3 by 4 cm) is the standard ID photo size in Brazil.

front: Os documentos estrangeiros precisam ser apostilados e ter tradução juramentada.
pronunciation: ooz doh-koo-MEHN-tooz ehs-trahn-ZHAY-rooz preh-SEE-zowng SEHR ah-pohs-chee-LAH-dooz ee TEHR trah-doo-SOWNG zhoo-rah-mehn-TAH-dah.
back: Foreign documents must be apostilled and have a sworn translation.
context: 'Apostila de Haia' = Hague apostille. 'Tradução juramentada' is done by a sworn public translator.

front: O agendamento na Polícia Federal é feito exclusivamente pela internet.
pronunciation: oo ah-zhehn-dah-MEHN-too nah poh-LEE-syah feh-deh-RAHL EH FAY-too ehs-kloo-zee-vah-MEHN-chee PEH-lah een-tehr-NEH-chee.
back: Appointments with the Federal Police are booked online only.
context: In Brazil, the Federal Police handle immigration: residence permits and the foreigner ID card (CRNM).

front: Depois de aprovada a residência, você receberá a Carteira de Registro Nacional Migratório.
pronunciation: deh-POYZ jee ah-proh-VAH-dah ah rreh-zee-DEHN-syah, voh-SEH rreh-seh-beh-RAH ah kahr-TAY-rah jee rreh-ZHEES-troo nah-syoh-NOW mee-grah-TOH-ryoo.
back: Once your residence is approved, you'll receive the National Migration Registry Card.
context: The CRNM is the ID card for foreign residents. 'Depois de aprovada' is a reduced participle clause: 'after it is approved'.

front: Sem CPF, não dá para abrir conta em banco nem assinar contrato de aluguel.
pronunciation: seng seh-peh-EH-fee, NOWNG DAH PAH-rah ah-BREER KOHN-tah eng BAHN-koo neng ah-see-NAHR kohn-TRAH-too jee ah-loo-GEH-oo.
back: Without a CPF, you can't open a bank account or sign a lease.
context: The CPF (taxpayer number) is issued by the Receita Federal and is required for almost everything in Brazil.

front: O comprovante de residência pode ser uma conta de luz ou de água em seu nome.
pronunciation: oo kohm-proh-VAHN-chee jee rreh-zee-DEHN-syah POH-jee SEHR OO-mah KOHN-tah jee LOOS oh jee AH-gwah eng SEH-oo NOH-mee.
back: Proof of address can be an electricity or water bill in your name.
context: 'Comprovante de residência' = proof of address, required in almost every bureaucratic process.

front: O prazo para recorrer da decisão é de dez dias úteis.
pronunciation: oo PRAH-zoo PAH-rah rreh-koh-RREHR dah deh-see-ZOWNG EH jee DEHS JEE-ahz OO-chays.
back: The deadline to appeal the decision is ten business days.
context: 'Dias úteis' = business days; 'dias corridos' = calendar days. 'Recorrer de' = to appeal against.

front: Guarde o número do protocolo para acompanhar o andamento do processo.
pronunciation: GWAHR-jee oo NOO-meh-roo doo proh-toh-KOH-loo PAH-rah ah-kohm-pah-NYAHR oo ahn-dah-MEHN-too doo proh-SEH-soo.
back: Keep the reference number to track the progress of your application.
context: 'Protocolo' = reference/case number. 'Andamento do processo' = status of the case or application.

front: Outorgo procuração ao meu advogado para me representar perante o órgão.
pronunciation: oh-TOHR-goo proh-koo-rah-SOWNG ah-oo MEH-oo ahj-voh-GAH-doo PAH-rah mee rreh-preh-zehn-TAHR peh-RAHN-chee oo OHR-gowng.
back: I grant my lawyer power of attorney to represent me before the agency.
context: 'Procuração' = power of attorney. 'Outorgar' (to grant) and 'perante' (before) are typical legal vocabulary.

front: Solicitei a segunda via da certidão de nascimento.
pronunciation: soh-lee-see-TAY ah seh-GOON-dah VEE-ah dah sehr-chee-DOWNG jee nah-see-MEHN-too.
back: I requested a new copy of my birth certificate.
context: 'Segunda via' = replacement copy of a document or bill. 'Certidão' = official certificate.

front: O documento perdeu a validade; será necessário renová-lo.
pronunciation: oo doh-koo-MEHN-too pehr-DEH-oo ah vah-lee-DAH-jee; seh-RAH neh-seh-SAH-ryoo rreh-noh-VAH-loo.
back: The document has expired; it will need to be renewed.
context: 'Perder a validade' = to expire. 'Renová-lo' = renew it (formal enclitic pronoun after an infinitive).

front: De acordo com a cláusula quinta, a manutenção do imóvel cabe ao proprietário.
pronunciation: jee ah-KOHR-doo kohng ah KLOW-zoo-lah KEEN-tah, ah mah-noo-tehn-SOWNG doo ee-MOH-vehl KAH-bee ah-oo proh-pree-eh-TAH-ryoo.
back: Under clause five, maintenance of the property is the landlord's responsibility.
context: 'Caber a alguém' = to be someone's responsibility. Clauses are numbered with ordinals: 'cláusula quinta'.

front: As partes elegem o foro da comarca de São Paulo para dirimir eventuais litígios.
pronunciation: ahs PAHR-cheez eh-LEH-zheng oo FOH-roo dah koh-MAHR-kah jee SOWNG POW-loo PAH-rah jee-ree-MEER eh-vehn-too-AHYS lee-CHEE-zhee-oos.
back: The parties choose the courts of the São Paulo district to settle any disputes.
context: Standard closing clause. 'Foro' = jurisdiction, 'comarca' = judicial district, 'dirimir' = to settle. 'Eventuais' means 'possible', not 'eventual'!

front: Li as letras miúdas antes de assinar e encontrei uma cláusula abusiva.
pronunciation: LEE ahz LEH-trahz mee-OO-dahz AHN-cheez jee ah-see-NAHR ee ehn-kohn-TRAY OO-mah KLOW-zoo-lah ah-boo-ZEE-vah.
back: I read the fine print before signing and found an unfair clause.
context: 'Cláusula abusiva' = unfair/abusive clause; the Consumer Defense Code (CDC) makes such clauses void.

front: Vou registrar uma reclamação no Procon contra a operadora.
pronunciation: VOH rreh-zhees-TRAHR OO-mah rreh-klah-mah-SOWNG noo proh-KOHNG KOHN-trah ah oh-peh-rah-DOH-rah.
back: I'm going to file a complaint with Procon against the phone company.
context: Procon is the state consumer protection agency. 'Operadora' = phone, internet or health-plan provider.

front: O serviço foi cancelado, mas continuaram cobrando a mensalidade.
pronunciation: oo sehr-VEE-soo FOY kahn-seh-LAH-doo, mahs kohn-chee-noo-AH-rowng koh-BRAHN-doo ah mehn-sah-lee-DAH-jee.
back: The service was cancelled, but they kept charging the monthly fee.
context: 'Cobrar' = to charge. 'Mensalidade' = monthly fee or subscription.

front: Peço a rescisão do contrato sem ônus, conforme previsto no Código de Defesa do Consumidor.
pronunciation: PEH-soo ah rreh-see-ZOWNG doo kohn-TRAH-too seng OH-noos, kohn-FOHR-mee preh-VEES-too noo KOH-jee-goo jee deh-FEH-zah doo kohn-soo-mee-DOHR.
back: I request termination of the contract at no cost, as provided for in the Consumer Protection Code.
context: 'Sem ônus' = at no cost/charge. 'Conforme previsto em' = as provided for in.

front: Fui contratado com carteira assinada, então tenho direito a férias e décimo terceiro.
pronunciation: FOO-ee kohn-trah-TAH-doo kohng kahr-TAY-rah ah-see-NAH-dah, ehn-TOWNG TEH-nyoo jee-RAY-too ah FEH-ryahz ee DEH-see-moo tehr-SAY-roo.
back: I was hired formally, so I'm entitled to paid vacation and a thirteenth salary.
context: 'Carteira assinada' = a formal employment contract under the CLT. The 'décimo terceiro' is an extra month's salary paid at year-end.

front: A rescisão do contrato de trabalho deve ser paga em até dez dias.
pronunciation: ah rreh-see-ZOWNG doo kohn-TRAH-too jee trah-BAH-lyoo DEH-vee SEHR PAH-gah eng ah-TEH DEHS JEE-ahs.
back: Severance must be paid within ten days.
context: In employment, 'rescisão' also refers to the severance payment. 'Em até' = within.

front: O governo disponibiliza o serviço gratuitamente no aplicativo gov.br.
pronunciation: oo goh-VEHR-noo jees-poh-nee-bee-LEE-zah oo sehr-VEE-soo grah-too-ee-tah-MEHN-chee noo ah-plee-kah-CHEE-voo GOHV POHN-too beh EH-rree.
back: The government offers the service for free in the gov.br app.
context: 'Disponibilizar' = to make available, a very common bureaucratic verb. Gov.br is Brazil's single login for federal public services.

front: Seu pedido foi indeferido por falta de documentação.
pronunciation: SEH-oo peh-JEE-doo FOY een-deh-feh-REE-doo pohr FAHL-tah jee doh-koo-mehn-tah-SOWNG.
back: Your application was rejected due to missing documents.
context: 'Deferido' = approved; 'indeferido' = rejected. You'll see these words in every Brazilian government portal.

front: O requerimento deve ser preenchido em letra de forma e assinado.
pronunciation: oo rreh-keh-ree-MEHN-too DEH-vee SEHR pree-ehn-SHEE-doo eng LEH-trah jee FOHR-mah ee ah-see-NAH-doo.
back: The application form must be filled out in block capitals and signed.
context: 'Requerimento' = formal application/petition. 'Letra de forma' = block letters.

front: Para fins de comprovação, anexe os três últimos holerites.
pronunciation: PAH-rah FEENZ jee kohm-proh-vah-SOWNG, ah-NEH-ksee ooz TREHZ OOL-chee-mooz oh-leh-REE-chees.
back: For verification purposes, attach your last three pay slips.
context: 'Holerite' / 'contracheque' = pay slip. 'Para fins de' = for the purpose of.

front: O imóvel está quitado e livre de quaisquer ônus.
pronunciation: oo ee-MOH-vehl ehs-TAH kee-TAH-doo ee LEE-vree jee kwahys-KEHR OH-noos.
back: The property is fully paid off and free of any encumbrances.
context: 'Quitado' = paid off. 'Quaisquer' is the plural of 'qualquer'. Ask for the 'matrícula' (title record) to confirm.

front: Peça a matrícula atualizada do imóvel no cartório de registro de imóveis.
pronunciation: PEH-sah ah mah-TREE-koo-lah ah-too-ah-lee-ZAH-dah doo ee-MOH-vehl noo kahr-TOH-ryoo jee rreh-ZHEES-troo jee ee-MOH-vays.
back: Request the up-to-date title record of the property from the land registry.
context: 'Matrícula' = the property's registry record showing owners, mortgages and liens.

front: A escritura só é lavrada depois do pagamento do ITBI.
pronunciation: ah ehs-kree-TOO-rah SOH EH lah-VRAH-dah deh-POYZ doo pah-gah-MEHN-too doo ee-teh-beh-EE.
back: The deed is only drawn up after the property transfer tax is paid.
context: 'Escritura' = deed; 'lavrar' = to draw up (a legal document). ITBI is the municipal property-transfer tax.

front: Estou isento da taxa por ser estudante de baixa renda.
pronunciation: ehs-TOH ee-ZEHN-too dah TAH-shah pohr SEHR ehs-too-DAHN-chee jee BAHY-shah RREHN-dah.
back: I'm exempt from the fee because I'm a low-income student.
context: 'Isento de' = exempt from; 'isenção' = exemption. 'Por ser' = because of being.

front: Declaro, sob as penas da lei, que as informações prestadas são verdadeiras.
pronunciation: deh-KLAH-roo, sohb ahs PEH-nahz dah LAY, keh ahz een-fohr-mah-SOYNGS prehs-TAH-dahs SOWNG vehr-dah-DAY-rahs.
back: I declare, under penalty of law, that the information provided is true.
context: Formula found at the end of official forms. 'Prestar informações' = to provide information.

front: O Senhor deverá comparecer pessoalmente munido dos documentos originais.
pronunciation: oo see-NYOHR deh-veh-RAH kohm-pah-reh-SEHR peh-soh-ah-oo-MEHN-chee moo-NEE-doo dooz doh-koo-MEHN-tooz oh-ree-zhee-NAHYS.
back: You must appear in person bearing the original documents.
context: Very formal register: 'o senhor' as 'you', 'comparecer' (to appear), 'munido de' (equipped with).

front: A notificação extrajudicial foi enviada pelo correio com aviso de recebimento.
pronunciation: ah noh-chee-fee-kah-SOWNG ehs-trah-zhoo-jee-SYOW FOY ehn-vee-AH-dah PEH-loo koh-RRAY-oo kohng ah-VEE-zoo jee rreh-seh-bee-MEHN-too.
back: The formal notice was sent by registered mail with return receipt.
context: 'Notificação extrajudicial' = formal notice outside court. 'AR' (aviso de recebimento) = return receipt.

front: Caso o débito não seja quitado, o nome do devedor será negativado.
pronunciation: KAH-zoo oo DEH-bee-too NOWNG SEH-zhah kee-TAH-doo, oo NOH-mee doo deh-veh-DOHR seh-RAH neh-gah-chee-VAH-doo.
back: If the debt isn't paid off, the debtor's name will be put on the credit blacklist.
context: 'Negativar o nome' = to report someone to credit bureaus (Serasa, SPC). 'Caso' + subjunctive = in case/if.

front: Entrei com uma ação no Juizado Especial Cível, que dispensa advogado para causas menores.
pronunciation: ehn-TRAY kohng OO-mah ah-SOWNG noo zhoo-ee-ZAH-doo ehs-peh-SYOW SEE-vehl, keh jees-PEHN-sah ahj-voh-GAH-doo PAH-rah KOW-zahs meh-NOH-rees.
back: I filed a claim at the small claims court, which doesn't require a lawyer for small cases.
context: 'Entrar com uma ação' = to file a lawsuit. The 'Juizado Especial Cível' handles small claims, many without a lawyer.

front: A audiência de conciliação foi marcada para o mês que vem.
pronunciation: ah ow-jee-EHN-syah jee kohn-see-lyah-SOWNG FOY mahr-KAH-dah PAH-rah oo MEHS kee VENG.
back: The settlement hearing was scheduled for next month.
context: 'Audiência' = court hearing. Conciliation is mandatory in many Brazilian civil procedures.

front: Assinei o distrato e agora estamos quites.
pronunciation: ah-see-NAY oo jees-TRAH-too ee ah-GOH-rah ehs-TAH-mooz KEE-chees.
back: I signed the termination agreement and now we're square.
context: 'Distrato' = mutual termination agreement. 'Estar quite(s)' = to owe nothing to each other.

front: O laudo técnico comprova que a infiltração já existia antes da mudança.
pronunciation: oo LOW-doo TEHK-nee-koo kohm-PROH-vah keh ah een-feel-trah-SOWNG ZHAH eh-zees-CHEE-ah AHN-cheez dah moo-DAHN-sah.
back: The technical report proves that the leak already existed before the move.
context: 'Laudo' = official/technical report. 'Infiltração' = water leak or damp in walls, a classic landlord-tenant dispute.

front: Por se tratar de um bem de família, o imóvel é impenhorável.
pronunciation: pohr see trah-TAHR jee oong BENG jee fah-MEE-lyah, oo ee-MOH-vehl EH eem-peh-nyoh-RAH-vehl.
back: Because it is a family home, the property cannot be seized.
context: 'Bem de família' = protected family home. 'Impenhorável' = exempt from seizure ('penhora').

front: O prazo prescricional para cobrar essa dívida já expirou.
pronunciation: oo PRAH-zoo preh-skree-syoh-NOW PAH-rah koh-BRAHR EH-sah JEE-vee-dah ZHAH ehs-pee-ROH.
back: The statute of limitations for collecting that debt has already expired.
context: 'Prescrição' = statute of limitations; 'prazo prescricional' = limitation period.

front: Mudei de endereço e preciso atualizar meu cadastro em todos os órgãos.
pronunciation: moo-DAY jee ehn-deh-REH-soo ee preh-SEE-zoo ah-too-ah-lee-ZAHR MEH-oo kah-DAHS-troo eng TOH-dooz ooz OHR-gowngs.
back: I moved and need to update my registration with every agency.
context: 'Cadastro' = registration/record, used everywhere in Brazil (banks, shops, government). 'Órgão' = public agency.

front: Desde que comprovada a união estável, o companheiro tem direito à autorização de residência.
pronunciation: DEHZ-jee keh kohm-proh-VAH-dah ah oo-nee-OWNG ehs-TAH-vehl, oo kohm-pah-NYAY-roo teng jee-RAY-too AH ow-toh-ree-zah-SOWNG jee rreh-zee-DEHN-syah.
back: Provided the common-law union is proven, the partner is entitled to a residence permit.
context: 'União estável' = recognized common-law partnership, with rights similar to marriage. Note the crase in 'direito à autorização'.

front: Recomendo que leia o contrato com calma e tire todas as dúvidas antes de assinar.
pronunciation: rreh-koh-MEHN-doo keh LAY-ah oo kohn-TRAH-too kohng KAHL-mah ee CHEE-ree TOH-dahz ahz DOO-vee-dahz AHN-cheez jee ah-see-NAHR.
back: I recommend you read the contract carefully and clear up any doubts before signing.
context: 'Recomendar que' + subjunctive ('leia', 'tire'). 'Tirar dúvidas' = to ask questions / clear up doubts.
